name: Amei Kanna
source:
A second year student in Nariyama Sky Academy.

Though it would be more appropriate to describe him as a dropout chasing his dreams. He treasures his mom's old gasoline-powered SUV vehicle.

He tends to stay in his house's garage due to his strained relationship with his father.

Incidentally, he's a cheeky cherry boy.

[From [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
